title: Days between two dates
source: MacStories documents 'Days Until…' as a canonical Shortcuts date action; ShortcutsGallery hosts a whole days-until countdown category. https://www.macstories.net/stories/shortcuts-rewind-dates-calendars-and-beyond/
signature: function daysUntil(fromISO, toISO)  // fromISO, toISO: 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> integer (toISO - fromISO in whole days)
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `daysUntil(fromISO, toISO)` that takes two dates as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings and returns the whole number of days from `fromISO` to `toISO` (toISO minus fromISO). The result is 0 for the same day and negative if `toISO` is earlier. Handle month lengths and leap years correctly; treat the dates as calendar days (no time zone effects).
